description: A project's sprints: its own board's in every state, and the open sprints of other projects' boards its issues may go into (a project whose sprints accept it) or already lie in. Each with id, name, goal, state (future / active / closed), startDate, endDate, completeDate, 'host' (the project whose board it is on) and 'kind' (own / accepts / holds), 'issues' and 'notDone' (how many of them are not finished), 'storyPoints' (total, done, remaining, unestimated) and 'projects' (whose issues they are: per project key, 'issues' and 'notDone') — over the issues you can open; 'hidden' counts the rest, never naming them. With withIssues=true, 'issueList' names each issue you can open — key, project, summary, status, done — up to 200 a sprint. Also 'canManage': whether you may make, start, change and complete this project's sprints. Any member may read them.

state.description: Only sprints in these states, comma-separated: 'active', 'future,active', 'closed'. Left out: all.

withIssues.description: true: also name each sprint's issues you can open, with their project ('issueList'), up to 200 a sprint. Left out: counts only.
